# Xenos
Xenos (xenomorphs) are aggressive alien life forms that hunt in packs. They have acidic blood, a hive mind, and the ability to force open doors. Butchering them yields xenomorph meat.
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]

# Mission Objectives ## Elimination
Eliminate the large and dangerous target—the [color=#a4885c]queen[/color]—within the allotted time.
## Destruction
Destroy the required number of [color=#a4885c]xeno warding towers[/color] within the allotted time.
